A is better. It stays within the 200-word limit, which B clearly exceeds at roughly 290 words. A also identifies more important technical issues. It notes that the `catch` block retries `AbortError` and permanent `TypeError` failures, which B misses. A also flags that the `as { refundId }` cast can return `undefined` as a successful refund ID, a real risk for a payments call. B's double-submit point is reasonable but less central than these.

A
